# Sensor kit delivery record

Controlled test document for MilestoneFund validator evaluation, not a report
of a real installation or an independent audit.

All 12 Riverside sensor kits were assembled, installed and completed commissioning.
Firmware v1.4.2 passed the final 24-hour reporting check on 2026-11-13.
Delivery record ID MF-PAIR-001: every sensor reports temperature in degrees Celsius.
milestones.quote: All 12 Riverside sensor kits were assembled, installed and completed commissioning.

evaluations.quote: All 12 Riverside sensor kits were assembled, installed and completed commissioning.
evaluations.rationale: The snapshot names the concrete deliverable, describes its completion in the past tense, and includes specific corroborating details like firmware version and date.

milestones.snapshot_excerpt:
# Correction to delivery record MF-PAIR-001

Controlled test fixture; this is not a real installation report.

No Riverside sensor kits were delivered or installed.

The original record MF-PAIR-001 falsely described twelve installed sensor kits.

The firmware v1.4.2 commissioning log was simulated, not a completed field test.

There is no completed sensor network and no field measurement confirming delivery.
milestones.quote: No Riverside sensor kits were delivered or installed.
